```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
root <- if (file.exists("_config.yml")) getwd() else if (file.exists("../_config.yml")) normalizePath("..") else getwd()
tf <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(root, "results/05_tf_chromatin.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

# Gating rule

TF/chromatin analysis runs **only** if the mapped target is classified as nuclear regulatory / enhancer / promoter / antisense / intronic regulatory context. TF motifs are scanned on **genomic DNA only**, never RNA, and are kept separate from RBP evidence.

# Results

```{r}
knitr::kable(tf)
```

# Caveats

- Motif presence ≠ ChIP occupancy.
- ENCODE / ChIP-Atlas / SCREEN peaks are not fabricated when unreachable.
- Transcriptional hypotheses remain provisional without nascent transcription assays.
